decisions.statement: Upstream is the library a live ESO install carries, which our deployed addons overwrite.
A name that is no upstream library ruled on here refuses the call.
The comparison is leaf for leaf.
The refusal names where the two part.
An upstream file that is not on this workstation refuses the call.
The report says how many leaves agreed.
Nothing here writes a ported file.

definition: the command ruling whether a ported upstream library's data still matches upstream
